doNow.prompt: A pupil says: the heart uses up the blood it pumps, so the body must keep making fresh blood. What is wrong with this idea?

choices.text: Nothing: the heart is supposed to use up blood
choices.misconception: The heart uses up the blood it pumps, so the body must keep making fresh blood.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option Nothing: the heart is supposed to use up blood as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of tracing the blood round its loop to check whether it returns to the heart.
rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: The heart uses up the blood it pumps, so the body must keep making fresh blood.. A pump feels like it burns fuel, so the blood seems to disappear as it travels. Blood is never used up: it keeps going round in a loop, coming back to the heart to be pushed around again. In the animation scene s4 the drop of blood travels out to the body and comes straight back to the heart, which shows the loop never uses the blood up.
